company.name: Blinkit
company.about: Blinkit (formerly Grofers) is an Indian quick-commerce platform that delivers groceries and daily essentials in minutes using a dense network of dark stores and delivery partners across Indian cities.

faq.a: Blinkit is an instant grocery and essentials delivery app in India that delivers items like fruits, vegetables, snacks, dairy, household items and more in minutes.
Yes — Blinkit is an Indian quick-commerce company. It was founded in India and operates across Indian cities.
Blinkit was previously known as Grofers. The company rebranded to Blinkit when it shifted its focus to ultra-fast deliveries.
Blinkit aims to deliver most orders in around 10 minutes in supported areas, using nearby dark stores and hyperlocal riders.
Blinkit serves many major Indian cities and urban areas. Availability depends on your pincode, which you can check in the Blinkit app or on the website.
Blinkit may charge a delivery fee depending on factors like order value, time of day, locality and ongoing offers. Some orders may qualify for free or discounted delivery.

faq.q: Does Blinkit have a minimum order value?
faq.a: Yes — there is usually a minimum order value which can vary by city and locality. The app shows you the applicable minimum for your area.

faq.q: What can I order on Blinkit?
faq.a: You can order groceries, fruits and vegetables, dairy, bakery, snacks, beverages, personal care, baby and pet care items, home essentials and more. The exact catalog may vary by location.
Blinkit is owned by Eternal Limited (formerly Zomato Limited), which acquired Blinkit in an all-stock deal.

faq.q: How can I contact Blinkit support?
faq.a: Customer support is available directly through the Blinkit app or website via the Help/Support section for order issues, refunds or replacements.

service_notes.delivery_promise: Instant commerce with grocery and essentials delivered in minutes via dark stores and hyperlocal delivery partners.
service_notes.note: Delivery time, fees, and availability depend on locality, time, demand and dark-store coverage. Exact offerings may vary by city.
